headline: Siti Networks Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Siti Networks Limited has informed that this is in continuation of our earlier communications (i.e. dated October 13, 2026), pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India…
detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Siti Networks Limited has informed that this is in continuation of our earlier communications (i.e. dated October 13, 2026), pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time ( Listing Regulations ), wherein we have informed that the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ( NCLT ) vide order dated September 28, 2026 (received on October 12, 2026) has appointed Mr. Trupalkumar Patel (having IP Registration No. IBBI/IPA-001/IP-P01186/2018-19/11907) as Resolution Professional of the Company

sources.name: NSE filing - Siti Networks Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
